name: table-card
description: Table shell with title/description, header actions, optional toolbar, edge-to-edge body and a footer row.
designIntent: Every list page rebuilds the same chrome around Table/DataTable: heading, count, actions, filter row, pagination. TableCard standardizes that shell so pages only supply the table.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Row between header and table (filters, bulk actions).

props.name: flush
props.description: Remove inner padding so the table reaches the card edges.

examples.title: List page table
examples.code:
<TableCard
  title="Classes"
  description="12 active"
  actions={<Button>New class</Button>}
  toolbar={<FilterBar … />}
  footer={<Pagination … />}
>
  <DataTable columns={columns} data={rows} />
</TableCard>
examples.description: Header, toolbar, table and pagination in one surface.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest another bordered card
antiPatterns.explanation: TableCard is the surface; wrapping it in Card double-borders the content.

accessibility.implementation: Title renders an h2 (page owns the h1 via PageHeader)
The table keeps its own caption/aria-label

guidelines: Pair with a count in description

compositionRules.relationship: Body content; use flush for edge-to-edge rows
Pass as toolbar for list filtering
